title.narrative: SAFEVEG - Safe locally-produced vegetables for West Africa's consumers

description.narrative: SAFEVEG aims to (i) reduce undernourishment, (ii) improved productivity and income, (iii) expand sustainable land use in Mali, Benin and Burkina Faso through: 1. Increased vegetable consumption 2. Increased productivity using climate-smart, sustainable good agricultural practices 3. Strengthened vegetable business 4. Strengthened evidence-basis for effective policies and interventions to increase vegetable production and consumption 5. Built capacity of the national agricultural research and extension systems
